scenarios.causalMutation: Claim arbitrary Lua execution during package materialization.
Emit two package rows with the same package id.

diagnostics.message: Every materialized package id must be unique.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a package plan row that does not exist in Goal 059.

diagnostics.message: Every package row must trace to a Goal 059 matrix row.

scenarios.causalMutation: Declare a Unity marker without staging a package file or requiring player log proof.

diagnostics.message: Unity markers must be matched in actual player logs.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a family outside the accepted Goal 059 family set.

diagnostics.message: Package family id must resolve to Goal 059 source families.

scenarios.causalMutation: Inject a seed outside the required seed set.

diagnostics.message: Package seed id must be one of seed_alpha, seed_beta or seed_gamma.

scenarios.causalMutation: Remove the accepted Goal 059 matrix source artifacts before loading.
Skip state-changing runtime commands for a materialized family.

diagnostics.message: Runtime proof requires a state-changing transition for every materialized family.

scenarios.causalMutation: Rebuild package rows in filesystem enumeration order instead of family/seed order.

diagnostics.message: Package materialization rows must use deterministic family/seed ordering.

scenarios.causalMutation: Let preview/export payload construction rewrite the materialized package JSON.

diagnostics.message: Preview/export payloads must not mutate package hashes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Write a package JSON file that cannot be parsed.

diagnostics.message: Materialized package files must be valid JSON.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use a package sidecar trace that points at a different Goal 059 row.

diagnostics.message: Package trace must match the Goal 059 row id/hash.

scenarios.causalMutation: Materialize a package that fails the existing GamePackage validator.
Claim provider, network, LLM/RAG or media generation execution.

diagnostics.message: Provider, network, LLM/RAG and media generation are forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Claim Runtime, Runtime.Abstractions, WinForms UI or broad Unity mutation.

diagnostics.message: Public GamePackage schema mutation is forbidden.

scenarios.causalMutation: Change a consumed Goal 059 row after its hash was recorded.

diagnostics.message: Source artifact bytes must match recorded hashes.

scenarios.causalMutation: Use absolute paths or traversal in package/staging refs.

diagnostics.message: Package artifact refs must stay safe relative paths.
